text:
Naked, dreaming a solar night.
+
+I have lain through animal days.
+
+The wind and rain erased me
+
+as they would a fire, as they would a poem
+
+written on a wall.

translation.title: Naked, Dreaming a Solar Night…
translation.editorial_note: Animal days retains the source’s compressed strangeness; the added pronoun in the erasure clarifies English agency without weakening the equivalence of body, fire, and wall-poem.
